nodes.label: AI Knowledge Base Index
nodes.rationale: Central index describing the structure, templates, contributing guidelines, integration points, and maintenance schedule for the AI chat agent's knowledge base.

nodes.label: AI Knowledge Base
nodes.rationale: Structured documentation exists to power the AI chat agent's domain expertise; written in business language for optical store operators (not developers), follows standardized templates, and is reviewed on a monthly schedule to stay accurate.

nodes.label: Embedding System
nodes.rationale: Produces vector representations of knowledge content for RAG retrieval (embeddings/generated cache + embeddings/models config).

nodes.label: Module Documentation Template
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive feature-documentation template covering Overview, Prerequisites, Key Workflows, Configuration, Use Cases, Troubleshooting, Error Codes, Integration Points, Best Practices, Training, FAQ, and Glossary.

nodes.label: Point of Sale (POS) and Retail Operations
nodes.norm_label: point of sale (pos) and retail operations

nodes.label: User Authentication and Account Management
nodes.rationale: Core security module using role-based permissions; all other system modules require authentication.

nodes.label: Two-Factor Authentication
nodes.rationale: Optional but recommended extra security layer; strongly encouraged for administrators and financial roles.

nodes.label: System Navigation Routes
nodes.rationale: Canonical admin route list that the AI agent MUST use when suggesting navigation or generating action_url in insights; /admin/settings deliberately does not exist (use /admin/system).

nodes.label: NOWPayments Gateway
nodes.rationale: Cryptocurrency gateway (Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT) with optional stablecoin auto-conversion and competitive 0.5%-1% transaction fees.

nodes.label: Mercado Pago Gateway
nodes.rationale: Default payment gateway; positioned for Latin America regional preferences and fee structures.

nodes.label: Flow Gateway
nodes.rationale: Gateway chosen for the Chile region.

nodes.label: PCI DSS Compliance
nodes.rationale: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard; rationale for never storing sensitive payment information locally and using tokenization.

nodes.label: Webhook
nodes.rationale: Automated HTTP callback for real-time payment status updates and system synchronization; needs signature verification and retry handling.

nodes.label: Structured Logging System (Pino)
nodes.rationale: Replaces console.log with environment-aware structured logging — readable/colored output (pino-pretty) in development, JSON for log aggregation in production.

nodes.label: pino-pretty
nodes.rationale: Used for human-readable colored log formatting in development only.

nodes.label: NOWPayments Integration
nodes.rationale: Enables crypto subscription payments via hosted invoice pages with HMAC-SHA512 verified IPN webhooks; signature verification must never be disabled in production.

nodes.label: SaaS Billing
nodes.rationale: Phase SaaS 1 — folder for Flow/Mercado Pago integration and subscription management.
